action_items: None — refinement is functionally complete and matches spec exactly.

(Optional / cosmetic) The stock/deal warning card uses a mid-amber (#F59E0B) border on a very light amber fill (#FEF3C755). On the dark theme this reads well, but the sub-text uses colors.textSecondary which appears slightly low-contrast (~2.6:1) against the amber tint. Consider bumping the sub-heading to colors.text for AA compliance.

(Optional / cosmetic) When the sub is IN_STOCK AND sold=true (server hard-stop path), the client-side evaluateResubmitState never actually branches — the frontend still shows canResubmit=true (because sub.stock_item_id is present but the client doesn't hydrate the stock_items collection). The 409 alert from the backend correctly handles this, but rendering a disabled button with copy 'Sold from stock — cannot be re-submitted' before the round-trip would be nicer. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py resubmit endpoint correctly orders the operations: fetch original → verify not retracted → verify status=priced → verify 14-day window → check stock sold hard-stop → build new doc → insert new → retract original with $unset of stock fields. Ordering is safe: if _build_submission_doc raises, original is not retracted, and the stock item is not touched.
Auto-untransfer only fires when stock_item_id is set. Sold hard-stop check happens BEFORE any state mutation — good.
The $unset payload sets stock_item_id/stock_number/transferred_to_stock_at/transferred_to_stock_by all in one update — atomic. Verified by pytest that the fields no longer exist on the retracted doc.

EditResubmitCard.tsx cleanly separates evaluateResubmitState (pure, testable) from the visual card. buildResubmitConfirmMessage returns copy that matches server intent — the client and server both agree that a sold stock item is a hard-stop; server enforces via 409 and the client card would still enable the button (see action item 3 above).
submissions.tsx has been fully cleaned — no orphaned canResubmit helper, no orphaned styles, no orphaned testIDs. Grep for 'resubmit' returns zero hits.

vehicle/[id].tsx wraps the card in `{!isCoverMode && isOwningDealer && !isAdmin && sub ? … : null}` — correct gate. Cover mode and admin viewing dealer submissions both hide the card as verified in the browser walk.

handleEditResubmit uses confirmAsync (Alert.alert on native, window.confirm on web). If a future refactor uses a custom Modal instead, ensure the state-aware message still surfaces the stock number / deal outcome — right now it's tied to buildResubmitConfirmMessage which is pure and reusable.
